text: The earlier promise, when it is recalled, makes the difference smaller than it seemed. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and the narrator, who has just told us so, makes of that promise a test. Everything turns on one word. Each time it means something different, and each time it costs more; it is _hineni_, "here I am," which Abraham speaks three times, to God, to Isaac, to the angel.
